title: descurainia incana var. brevipes
intro: Descurainia incana var. brevipes, commonly known as hoary whitetop or hoary tumble mustard, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Descurainia incana var. brevipes include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, which have been shown to have anti-cancer properties, and other compounds such as flavonoids and phenolic acids that have been reported to have various therapeutic effects.
